messages:
Ari: quick sync — want to tighten our competitive scripts before next webinar and update the inbound routing snippets. I made a terse matrix (latency, cost, rollout, private options) here: https://redwood.internal/drive/market-scripts-evalpad (please don't share externally yet)
Devon: loading now. do we want separate one-pagers for cloud AI vendors vs infra partners or a single comparison deck?
Priya: separate one-pagers would be nicer for field. Cloud AI asks = focus on managed endpoints + pricing opacity. Infra vendors = self-host ops burden + optimization gaps.
Ari: agree. two artifacts: 1) Field-ready one-pagers (2 slides each) 2) Short rebut script (3 quick lines) that SDRs can paste into replies.
Sam: can we include a tiny benchmark soundbite? e.g., "median 99th pct latency 180ms in hosted; single-digit token $/k improvement with cache + quantization on Dedicated" — keep conservative numbers.
Lee: also add the fallback story: when capacity constrained we auto-route to cheaper compatible variants w/ no API changes. that's a clear technical hook.
Priya: + mention private deployment: "VPC/private control plane + KMS/HSM options" — customers ask this constantly.
Ari: draft rebut scripts below — very short, pick one for email/snippet: ```1) We prioritize predictable serving economics — same API & SLA across hosted, dedicated, and private. 2) We optimize for production token cost (auto-batching, KV/prefix caching, quantization recommendations) so you keep model quality while cutting unit spend. 3) We provide model fallbacks & routing policies to avoid downtime during capacity spikes.```
Devon: these read well. can we reword #2 to sound less infra-y for sales: "We reduce per-token cost without sacrificing quality using smart batching, caching, and model tuning".
Ari: updated in draft doc.
Sam: routing: include a short YAML snippet for inbound routing rules that Solutions Engineers can drop into demos. e.g.,
```yaml
routing:
  - priority: latency
    route_to: redwood-low-latency
  - priority: cost
    route_to: redwood-cheap-variant
  - fallback: model-quantized-8bit
```
Priya: love the YAML. also add 1-2 competitor claims to rebut under each heading. like for "managed cloud": "they expose model variants but customers still wrestle with burst costs and inconsistent latency".
Lee: can someone add quick battlecard soundbites for infra vendors re: "ops burden" vs our "managed runtime + on-prem package".
Devon: I'll take infra vendor one-pager. Sam will do cloud AI one-pager. Priya will surface top 5 customer Qs to handle on page 2.
Ari: timeline: draft PR by EOD today, internal review tomorrow morning, final to enable field by Thursday. tagging ops-bot to create an edit link.
ops-bot: Created doc "market-scripts-evalpad/drafts/2354759123" and granted edit to Ari, Devon, Priya, Sam, Lee.
Sam: adding a short webinar-friendly slide (single chart + 3 bullets) — will keep <2 minutes on the slide.
Ari: perfect. small ask for SDRs: please use the 1-line lead with link + one chosen rebut line. I'll attach copy variants in the doc.
Devon: noted. putting task in marketing board.
Priya: quick note — avoid the phrase "cheaper" in external copy; use "cost-efficient" or "unit-economics". small edit across all scripts.
Ari: good catch, done.
Sam: thumbs up. I'll open the PR in 30.
Devon: thanks — excited to see this shipped. :rocket:
